reviews.text: We just had our first training session and I feel so hopeful. Rachel is amazing and so friendly, I felt very comfortable with her. She handled our dog really well and he actually did pretty good! I have so much  more confidence now.

Myself and pups had the best training  experience with Rachel.   Communication was great as were results! After just one meeting I saw huge improvement in my dogs behaviors and it just got better with each session .  I would highly recommend!

Rachael has been such a blessing in our life!!! We got Finn from the shelter almost 2 years ago, and while my wife and I loved him so much, he had no small amount of challenges. He was severely reactive towards dogs and cats, and had pulled my wife down the stairs to chase after a small dog. For more than a year my wife couldn't take him on a walk outside, and his behavior in the house wasn't much better. Since training with Rachael, our life has changed so much for the better. My wife can take Finn outside for his walks, just last week we went to the mall and did a walk with several other dogs, and he did amazing. Now we're training Finn to take the Good Canine Test, something we never would have dreamed possible.

I got a dog that had been returned to the pound twice. He weighed 50lbs and I have a few mobility issues. I tried walking him and it was awful, he was reactive to everything, and terrible on the leash. I found Rachael on FB and contacted her. I signed up for 3 sessions. I thought that she was just going to help me with walking, but she came over and suggested other changes that made it a much happier home (he’s very active and ball obsessed). I can now walk him with confidence and at home he is a lot calmer. He’s such a sweet boy. Rachael helped turn him from an out of control dog into a calmer, happier version of himself. I love him even more now! Thanks Rachael!!

We adopted a rescue dog that we loved, but his aggressive behavior around our grandkids and anyone entering our home had us face a decision to get him training or surrender him, which would have broken our hearts. Thanks to Rachael at Paws Down Dog Training, our pup is now calm, obedient, and interacts great with our grandkids, family, and visitors.
Rachael was amazing. She took the time to understand his behavior, gave us the tools and confidence to work with him, and was incredibly patient throughout the process.
We are forever grateful and highly recommend Rachael to anyone struggling with their dog’s obedience and/or behavior.

We are so pleased with Rachel! We went out of the country and I was beside myself leaving our new golden puppy (Rocky). It was the best decision we ever made. Her home is a perfect environment and she treated our puppy like part of the family. She sent videos and kept us informed. He was so well cared for and she spent hours every day working with him. She made so much progress with improving his puppy manners, basic commands and beyond. He came home happy and healthy and a much better version of himself. She allowed him to be a puppy and keep his loveable personality but he is the best behaved puppy we have ever had. I only wish I found her sooner! Thank you Rachel

Rachael is fantastic! Highly recommend. I was at my wits end when I called her to help me with my 6 month old rescue puppy Roxy. Giving up was not an option for me. She tailors her training to the individual dog and what will work for her.  Rachael makes everything seem so logical and simple.  She sends you notes after each training session so you can go back over them to refresh your memory and also makes herself available for any questions you might have.  She took my  Roxy from being a little crazy puppy to a well behaved girl. I cant say enough good things about her. Look no further do yourself a favor and call her. You will not regret it.

We couldn’t be happier with our experience with our dog trainer Rachael! She was absolutely amazing from start to finish. She was patient, knowledgeable, and truly cared about helping both us and our dog succeed. We saw such a huge improvement in behavior, listening, and confidence in such a short time. She made training enjoyable and easy to understand, and she always took the time to answer our questions. We highly recommend her to anyone looking for a caring and talented dog trainer. Thank you for everything!

We had such a great experience with Rachael! She did a great job at training our dog Lola as well as us. We had a dog that was super reactive to other dogs that came off very aggressive and somewhat frightening for the other dog. Through our sessions we were able really help Lola not react or to not react negatively when she saw other dogs. This has made camping with Lola 100% more enjoyable. My wife and I would highly recommend her.

Rachel is amazing and truly has a gift for dog training. We are lucky to have found her as we did one on one training. She helped us with training our golden retriever puppy. As we all know puppies can be overwhelming. With her guidance and support our puppy is learning and quickly (place, sit, down, leave it, walking, greetings, no, yes, etc. etc. etc.). Her videos are also very helpful.

Thank you Rachael for patiently teaching our puppy better dog manners. Our girl has learned to go on a walk better, wait for permission before going out a door, sit, stay, down, place, leave it and more. We contacted several trainers before deciding on Paws Down Dog Training. We struggled to find one where we were comfortable leaving our baby. We could tell that Rachael has a love and passion for dogs, and our girl was still sweet and happy when training was over. We highly recommend Paws Down Dog Training.

We are so grateful for the sessions we had with Rachael. Her guidance is very clear, easy to understand and follow through with. She helped us help our girl to gain the confidence she needed around new people and places, as well as with some basic day to day skills she needed,  so she can be happy and without all the nervousness. Our sessions took place at her home, our home, and at at park. She is very responsive to text questions, even when we found ourselves in a pickle prior to our first scheduled session. If you need some help with your pup, and are willing to follow through with the guidance you are given, you will have great success with your sessions.

Rachel is absolutely phenomenal! About a month we got a puppy and had no idea what were getting ourselves into. From the extreme biting, to several potty accidents in the house. We reached out to Rachel because we didn’t know how to appropriately train our buddy! We decided to immediately do a board and train with Rachel, where Benny was with Rachel for two weeks and learning fundamental skills such as how to potty outside, crate training, and how to control his impulsive, and basic obedience. Im telling you that Benny came home and is fully going potty OUTSIDE, is listening to basic commends, is so regulated and calm, and just such overall good pup. My hats off to Rachel and her fantastic work! I refer her to anyone that needs support with their animals!

We loved working with Rachael! We did her group puppy class for our 6 month old mini poodle. It gave our pup more confidence and it gave US more confidence I her training. We would recommend Rachael to anyone looking for a trainer in the North Valley!

Rachel with Paws Down Dog Training was wonderful to work with. She helped us so much with puppy training, especially teaching us how to stop our dog from jumping on guests when they come into our home. After each of the three sessions, we saw noticeable improvement, which was incredibly encouraging. Rachel explained everything clearly and showed us techniques we could confidently continue on our own. The key is being consistent and keeping up with the training, and she really set us up for success. I highly recommend her!

Working with Rachael was exactly what I needed to start walking my large dog again.  She gave me all the tools I needed to regain control and confidence.  I’m also working on “place” so guests can come into my home without a dog in their face.  In only 3 lessons, Cooper has made so much progress!  We are very happy!

So very grateful to have found Rachael through the recommendation of Paw Posse Dog Rescue, Traci Cook.  In just two sessions, we learned so much on how to be better dog parents to our puppy and Lucy took to the training like a duck to water!  Rachael really cares about the dogs she works with and it shows.  If you are looking for a good dog trainer, Rachael is well worth the investment!

I met Rachael after adopting my dog from a rescue. He is about a year old and poor guy has been through a lot. He is high energy and requires a lot of attention and training. I have only had him for a little over 3 months and have been working with Rachael for a little less than that. It is AMAZING the amount of progress we have made working with her! She is knowledgeable, kind, clear with her direction and most importantly, she really cares about what is best for me and my dog. ❤️🥰 I am so grateful for her!! She is patient and encouraging as this is the first time I have ever done real training with a dog. I highly recommend her services!

Rachel is the best

After interviewing and using 3 different dog trainers, we were referred to Rachel’s Paws Down Dog Training.  What a wonderful experience!

We rescued a large mixed breed Pitty, who was at a rescue for several years.  His social skills were poor, he dragged us down the street when walking him, he thought he was the boss, and he had a strong prey drive.  He was a handful, but also a loving dog that we adored.

We started with 3 sessions after she evaluated our dog.  Every session we learned something new.  Rachel’s methods made sense.  She rewarded him with some treats, but didn’t bribe him into behaving with the use of treats, she used praise and attention.  Our dog loves her!!
She is gentle but yet firm, she taught us as much as she taught our dog.
She emphasizes playing with your dog, working on the techniques she presents.  I believe you have to practice what she teaches you.  She worked with us in our home, in our neighborhood, in the park, and in Home Depot.  She showed us how to get him to calm down when someone new came into our home.  She advised a prong collar, which one to buy, and when and how to use it, without hurting him.  With the prong collar his leash manners are much, much improved. Our dog now knows basic commands, and he will do these commands without bribing him with a treat.

After the first 3 sessions, we were so happy with his progress, we signed up for another 3 sessions.  I found her prices reasonable, and turned out to be priceless in the end

We cannot say enough great things about Rachael! She has completely exceeded our expectations. Rachael started working with our Golden Retriever puppy, Mila, when she was just 4 months old, and the progress has been incredible. Mila is now such a well-behaved, confident, and happy puppy thanks to Rachael’s patient, knowledgeable, and consistent training methods.

Rachael goes above and beyond—she’s always available to answer our (many!) questions and helps us fine-tune every aspect of Mila’s training. She has even helped us with our 9-year-old Mini Aussie, offering personalized guidance that’s made a big difference for her too.

Rachael is professional, kind, and truly passionate about what she does. We couldn’t recommend her more highly—she’s simply the best! 👏🏻
Rachel is really unmatched in her ability to train and connect with dogs! She's thorough, meticulous, ethical and kind!! Staten loves you and we do too!! Thank you for your help ❤️

Rachael is simply amazing! When we first reached out to her we needed help with basic commands but most importantly, with how our pup addressed new people when they came into our home. We were lost and everything we were trying wasn’t working.

From the first meet and greet she provided us with so much hope and a solid plan and in just over 1 month, we have noticed tremendous progress. I truly cannot thank her enough for improving all of our quality of life together. She provided us with all the tools we need to be confident- we are so grateful for her!

She is also so supportive and responsive in between sessions which we found really helpful as we were learning just as much as our pup. She is timely,  affordable, and just really kind to both humans and dogs. You can really tell she loves what she does and is passionate about helping you and your dogs live better together. Cannot recommend her enough!

I’m a professional dog trainer myself, and I can confidently say that Rachael with Paws Down Dog Training is a cut above the rest. I’ve personally witnessed the amazing transformations her dogs go through during training, and it’s nothing short of incredible. She’s extremely knowledgeable, truly knows her stuff, and brings a burning passion for helping both dogs and their people.

What sets Rachael apart is her ability to combine skill, structure, and compassion to get real results. Watching the dogs in her program grow in confidence, obedience, and overall happiness is inspiring. She doesn’t just train dogs—she changes lives. If you’re looking for a trainer who genuinely cares and delivers outstanding results, Rachael is the one.

Rachael did an amazing job with our pup Coco, and with us too. She explained every step so well that it made it easy and fun to continue the training. She even checks in on us from time to time to see how Coco is doing. Thank you very much Rachael, job well done!

I have nothing but positive things to say about Rachel and what she’s accomplished with Indy. Indy is super energetic and came to her with some bad habits. Rachel was thoughtful in her approach to what we could accomplish and has us on a path for success. Indy is much better with basic commands, leash manners and is calmer in the home - especially when greeting guests! Rachel trains to the personality of each pup and Indy clearly loved her, her calm demeanor and clear commands. I much appreciated that she checks in with me and follows up to answer questions - I couldn’t recommend her more highly and plan to continue additional training in the future!

I’ve worked with quite a few dog trainers over many years of dog ownership, and Rachel is by far the best! She’s realistic, practical, and never tries to overhaul the way you live with your pets. Instead, she meets you where you’re at. Rachel is personable, gentle yet firm, and has made life with our three crazy pups so much easier. I can’t recommend her highly enough!

We are so grateful to have found Rachael! What we loved about her training style is that she is very balanced and works with you and your dogs as opposed to having a “one size fits all” approach. She is very patient, knowledgeable & really helps you understand the why behind each step you take. Our dogs are absolutely more confident, regulated & understanding of what we expect out of them and are happier for it!

Rachael has done amazing things for my dog! She is great to work with and I recommend her to everyone! Training your dog is a lot of work but Racheal really guides you through the whole process wonderfully!

Would recommend Rachel to anyone looking for dog training! Our dog had some serious resource guarding, we had got him training from another trainer and it did not help at all. Paws down was able to come in and help so much in a very short amount of time. She was very helpful and super responsive. We plan to use her again when we get another dog/puppy. Would highly recommend her!

Rachael is an outstanding dog trainer. From the very beginning, she took the time to truly understand our dog, Sunny—her personality, behaviors, and specific needs. Her patience and calm demeanor created a positive environment for both Sunny and us to learn. Rachael not only explained the what of each behavior, but also the why, which helped us better understand and support Sunny's progress.

She was clear and consistent in setting expectations, and she demonstrated each command before guiding us step by step through the training process. Thanks to Rachael’s thoughtful approach, Sunny has made an incredible transformation. She’s now much more confident and comfortable with people in our home. We can’t recommend  Rachael highly enough—her expertise, care, and professionalism made a world of difference.

We are so grateful to be referred to Rachael to work with our rescue pittie. She has an obvious passion for the dogs and she is so patient and kind with the owners as well. She was willing to work us into her schedule right away and is always responsive and willing to help with issues or questions. We have seen an immediate improvement in our dog and Rachael gave us the tools we need to keep it going even when she’s not with us. We cannot speak highly enough of her and highly recommend her services!

I have two large, high energy, adopted dogs with some special quirks and features, and Rachael is the only one I will trust to watch them when we go out of town. I can’t leave my babies with just anyone, but I have no worries or concerns when Rachael is watching them. They get so excited when they realize we are going to see her!! She treats them like family and is accommodating to their unique needs. If you want to feel relaxed and confident about your pets while you are away, this is your place. They always come home happy and exhausted!

We are so blessed to find Rachael, she is an excellent communicator, both with humans and dogs. She’s very practical and loving which helped our 5lb pomchi puppy, who has confidence and anxiety issues feel relaxed, just during our second meeting. We are retired and travel often, and we wanted him to be more adaptable and less nervous in various situations and environments. She gave us work to do at home, which was super helpful and we were thankful for her easy tips to help our puppy with his specific issues. Some of our dog’s issues stemmed from us, and Rachael was not judgmental and really kind in helping us too.

Wonderful experience. Rachael helped our dog (mini golden doodle) learn better leash manners (was pulling), stop jumping on guests and stay in place. Most of all she taught us parents (and our daughter) how to train the dog and what tools (e.g leash and treats to buy). We had called a different dog trainer first and were told the only way to help our dog was one week of boarding which was going to be thousands of dollars. I called Paws Down Dog Training and she said she could help in 1-2 hr lessons. I said I’ll buy the three lesson package and she said, you will only need two max, I don’t want u to buy more than u need. Such honesty and fair pricing. She came to our house right on time and even stayed a little while extra. Could tell she really cared about the outcome and our dog. Highly recommend
Rachael did an Amazing job today training my Goldendoodle (Angus) walking with out him jumping and darting off.  She really is Great with dogs and knows her stuff!   Thank you again Rach!
Thank you Andy!

I 1000% recommend Rachel!  After failed training with another company I felt a little defeated with my 50lb Australian Shepard, Bear.  Rachel took the time to listen to my needs, frustration on what wasn’t working, and the very small time frame I had before moving out of state.  She communicated her thoughts and how to approach training.  After one session Bear was responsive.  I took what Rachel taught and applied it to each daily walk.  Bear had severe dog reactivity on walks to the point he’d lunge and almost flip in the air.  I’m so happy to say when we encounter another dog he is aware of the other dog but does not go into a heightened reactivity.  Thanks Rachel!!

Rachel was incredible! We worked with her for our 4 month old puppy and we are so happy with her training. She was very communicative with us and took the time to educate us and make sure my husband and I each understood the training. Our pup is quite smart but also quite stubborn and Rachel gave us so many tools to work with him and help him be successful!

I want to express how happy I am with the training that my dog Kane got with Rachael! He's a 160 pound mastiff mix and he has a mind of his own so walking or even getting him to pay attention was a chore. After a week of board and train with Rachael I can honestly say walks are enjoyable and he even sits before going out the door! So much more manageable and much more fun to have him around! Now if she could just stop the slobber :) I highly recommend Paws Down and Rachael and will utilize her skills for my other dogs!

We are so grateful for the opportunity to work with Rachel with our rescue, Diesel! I truly feel Rachel trained us more than the dog, which is a shocking reality when it comes to dog training. Her knowledge and insight on every area of concern with him was so helpful. Rachel helped us tremendously with leash pulling, recall, stay and several other areas of concern.  It was an absolute pleasure working with her! We highly recommend her!!

A BIG thank you to Rachael for her help with the training of our two rescue dogs one which is deaf. We signed up for six lessons to get help with numerous issues. First and foremost, our one dog had anxiety/fear issues due to someone in our neighborhood setting off fireworks while we were on a walk just after dinner on New Years Eve.  Rachael gave numerous tips and helped by walking our dog while teaching both the dog and us the best way to handle the anxiety. We also had help with getting them to heal, stay, and not react to someone at the door. We also took them into an outdoor mall setting to get them to listen to our commands even with many distractions. Our dogs no longer chase after rabbits, cats, react to other dogs or people while on walks. She did a great job training our dogs and us and it has made a big difference to our every day lives. I highly recommend her!

Rachael is awesome!  Very easy to get a hold of and to schedule with her. She worked with me and my pup on leash training and made it very simple for me. She was successful at getting him used to walking on the leash in a short amount of time and gave me simple instructions to keep working with him.  If you want a good trainer, contact her. You won’t be disappointed.

Rachel is AMAZING and has helped train our super high energy GSP. She is kind, caring and gave Bailey extra love too. Bailey has been much more obedient since we got her back home and we look forward to continuing training with her!

Rachael helped me determine the best approach and corrective measures needed with our new puppy.  She is extremely responsive and willing to give you the time and tools needed to eliminate some of the frustrations that come with a new furry family member.

We feel so fortunate to have connected with Rachel. In short order, she was able to determine our needs - 2 doting seniors who want a well behaved but spoiled puppy. We 3 (puppy included)
received sensible, achievable guidance to insure appropriate puppy boundaries, behavior and socialization. Her guidance was easy for us to follow through with and it all worked. Almost instantly! We are extremely happy with our decision to enlist Rachel. Money well spent. We look forward to connecting and sharing our puppy’s development in the future. She’s the best!
After just one session our 70 lbs Doodle was pulling less and checking in more. Rachael gave me the confidence and tips to be consistent and inspired me to keep practicing!

Rachel has done an amazing job helping us learn the tools to help our stranger danger pup! I appreciate how she learned about P, us, and our home, and tailored the training to our specific needs. She is incredibly patient, explains things very well and is our biggest cheerleader. I am so thankful we found Rachel and have learned so many great skills from her!!

Rachael has been amazing! After only 2 sessions my one year old husky shepherd rescue has done a 💯 % turnaround! , she is listening, and is behaving so much better already!  It’s a training,  learning curve for all of us. She is very knowledgeable and can’t thank her enough! …

Rachael is incredibly passionate about dogs and has such a genuine love for them. She provided a safe and calming environment for my dog who is scared of fireworks and did a great job of getting my dog acclimated to being around children and other animals.

Rachael does a fantastic job and has a passion for working with dogs that I'm sure is rare even in the dog training community. She is patient, and understands what pet owners need to have a successful and happy relationship with their four-legged family members. Great job Rachael and it's nice to know we can lean on you anytime we need help.
Rachael is an amazing dog trainer! I have a 60lbs pitbull that was having potty training issues and she got her potty training done in 1 week!!! Rachael was very kind and supportive to work with.

Rachel is very knowledgeable, patient and we actually learned a lot about our approach to training our chihuahua, Pebbles.  We still have work to do, but the tools she gave us has allowed us to recognize what we need to do for Pebbles to feel confident and calm in her home.
Rachael is a great person who is very dedicated in helping train your dog. If you are in need of help with yours, I would definitely recommend!

Rachel did an amazing job explaining, teaching, and implementing the skills necessary to train our hyper active rescue dog. She was patient with us as we had never had formal training before. The dogs respond very well to training from Rachel and her techniques . We appreciated her approach to first learn our dog and our concerns and then step up corrections only as necessary.
Highly recommend her for anyone with training needs!

I can’t say enough good things about Rachael and her kindness and training abilities! After struggling with our dog Roo’s leash pulling, we decided to give Rachael’s training a try, and I am so glad we did! From the first session we noticed a huge difference! She was patient with Roo and most importantly she was patient with me!! Her techniques and knowledge were clear and easy to put to use. We only got our second dog, because we knew she could help us make it work!

Rachael was a delight to work with. Our dog is a mix from a shelter and was very skittish when we got him. He is 7 months old and would not walk with a leash. In fact we couldn't even get him out the front door. Rachael came to our residence and with one visit she had a leash on him and walking outside in the front! It's still a work in progress, but with Rachael's help we can now take him on walks! She was very gentle but firm with him and offered suggestions how to deal with the skittishness. I would definitely recommend her for help with your dog.

rachel is amazing to work with. from day 1 she took time to understand our issues and tailored her approach to develop our unpredictable dog into one we felt confident bringing out in public. no more fear of him lunging and going cray cray when another dog walks by. the change took time, but we are so thankful we took this leap of faith to transform his life and ours.

Rachael is amazing! Her patience, compassion and skills have transformed our wild child into a responsive respectful member of our family. She trains dogs along with their humans, results are remarkable. Her dedication is beyond any other pet professional we have encountered. Highly recommend Paws Down Dog Training!
You will not find a more dedicated and passionate dog trainer! Rachael is kind, loving and patient and your precious pup will be in the best hands!
Rachael is very attentive and passionate! She truly cares about dogs, and is patient and understanding in her approach. Look no further for your pups training needs!
Rachael is very dedicated to her passion with dogs! You won't be disappointed with her dog training program!
